name: @avalaym/mssql-mcp
description: MCP Server for MS SQL Server integration with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf and VS Code

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run check:tests && npm run check:version
scripts.test: node --test dist/tests/unit/validators.test.js dist/tests/unit/query-builders.test.js dist/tests/unit/tool-contracts.test.js dist/tests/unit/markdown.test.js dist/tests/unit/errors.test.js dist/tests/unit/config.test.js dist/tests/unit/format.test.js dist/tests/unit/repo-guards.test.js dist/tests/unit/connection-config.test.js dist/tests/unit/connection-poison.test.js dist/tests/unit/read-only.test.js dist/tests/unit/run-read-only.test.js dist/tests/unit/session.test.js dist/tests/unit/server-modes.test.js
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test

author: Angel Valay (https://github.com/avalaym)
